highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap-rendering performance while advancing to Skia m151.
highlights_body: Color conversion, tag parsing, and shaped-text extraction do less work. New span overloads avoid substring allocations, and matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives address linking and exception-handling mismatches.

breaking.title: Color hex parsing rejects whitespace after the prefix
breaking.body: SKColor.Parse and TryParse no longer accept whitespace immediately after # in the six- and eight-digit paths. Remove that whitespace before parsing. Case-insensitive hex parsing and outer whitespace trimming remain supported.

bullets.detail: Advances the bundled renderer from m150 without changing the existing C API surface.
SKColor.Parse/TryParse, SKFourByteTag.Parse, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse accept ReadOnlySpan<char> so slices can be parsed without allocating substrings.

bullets.lead: Scaled and tiled CPU bitmap rendering restored
bullets.detail: Restores the optimized legacy shader-context path for software bitmap draws that had regressed in earlier Skia milestones.

bullets.lead: Ganesh stencil and resolve tracking corrected
bullets.detail: Tracks stencil clears in native coordinates, ensures preserve-mode clears occur, and unwinds dirty tracking when a resolve task does not execute.
Fixes use-after-free and invalid frees when a corrupt Slug buffer fails deserialization.

bullets.lead: Faster color conversions with identical results
bullets.detail: SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply use managed math rather than a native transition.
HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) pools its encoding buffer, while SKShaper reads glyph results through zero-copy spans instead of two temporary arrays.
SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) deterministically disposes the full-size intermediate when Subset returns a different image, without changing output.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 archives and the exnref exception model for .NET 11 preview 6+ consumers. .NET 8 keeps 3.1.34 and .NET 9/10 keep 3.1.56 with their legacy exception model.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added .NET 11 WebAssembly native assets and cross-backend visual regression coverage, and removed redundant WASM build warnings

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the Skia m151 line without changing the managed API surface.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added span-based color and tag parsing, reduced shaping allocations, and corrected malformed native text cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate restored CPU bitmap performance, optimized color math, fixed subset-image cleanup, and aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and exception handling.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds span-based tag parsing and pooled UTF-8 string encoding, and ships Emscripten 5.0.6 native archives for .NET 11 consumers. The native HarfBuzz version remains 14.2.1.

v4.151.0-preview.1.1.headline: Preview 1 opened the Skia m151 line without changing the managed API surface.

v4.151.0-preview.2.1.headline: Preview 2 added span-based color and tag parsing, reduced shaping allocations, and corrected malformed native text cleanup.

v4.151.0-rc.1.1.headline: The release candidate restored CPU bitmap performance, optimized color math, fixed subset-image cleanup, and aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets and exception handling.

v4.151.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 promotes the release candidate to stable without additional collected changes.
